content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Github pages

GitHub Pages is a free hosting service that allows you to publish static websites directly from a GitHub repository. It matters because it provides digital creators with a reliable, cost-effective way to set up an online store without the penalties associated with conventional payment platforms. In a landscape where many creators are locked out by restrictive payment systems, GitHub Pages serves as a bastion of sovereignty, enabling you to fully control your digital commerce without ongoing costs or subscription fees.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a GitHub Pages store involves several key components that work together seamlessly. You host your site on GitHub Pages, utilize Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend functionality, and integrate NOWPayments for cryptocurrency processing. This stack allows for automated product delivery, instant payment verification, and complete ownership of your data. The entire system is designed to operate without conventional banking interference, allowing you to transact freely, ensuring that your digital products reach customers without the hindrance of payment rejections.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This setup is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where access to mainstream payment processors is limited or non-existent. Whether you're selling ebooks, courses, or design templates, this architecture offers a robust framework for success. By removing reliance on platforms that charge high fees, you can focus on creating quality content, knowing that your sales are secure and that you keep more of the profits. This infrastructure empowers creators in economically challenging environments to build sustainable income streams.
GitHub Pages lets you host your products for free, enhancing your profit margin.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The primary components of your GitHub Pages digital product store include GitHub for hosting, Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend processes, and NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions. Each component is chosen for its reliability, cost-effectiveness, and performance. By leveraging these tools, you ensure that your store not only functions smoothly but also remains scalable as your needs grow. This combination removes the complexities typically associated with traditional e-commerce setups, allowing you to focus on your creations rather than the infrastructure.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your GitHub Pages digital store, first, set up a GitHub account and create a new repository for your website. Next, upload your site files and configure the repository to serve the site via GitHub Pages. Once your site is live, implement Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend functionality, linking them to your payment processing through NOWPayments. Finally, test the entire setup to ensure seamless product delivery and payment confirmation. By following these steps, you'll have a fully operational digital storefront ready for business.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
NOWPayments charges only 0.5% per transaction, compared to Gumroad's 10%.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking for a comprehensive solution that includes everything you need to build and deploy your digital product store, check out our Complete Builder Kit for $197. It includes all six blueprints and seven templates for immediate download at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.

You can sell ebooks online by creating a store on GitHub Pages and using NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions. This setup allows you to fully control your sales while avoiding traditional payment platforms.

Utilizing GitHub Pages for hosting combined with NOWPayments for crypto payments is an effective way to sell digital downloads. This solution eliminates high platform fees, ensuring you retain more of your profits.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?

Yes, you can sell templates and fonts using GitHub Pages as your store's hosting platform. Integrating NOWPayments allows you to accept payments without the fees associated with platforms like Gumroad.
How do I automate product delivery for my digital store?

You can automate product delivery by using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to handle the fulfillment process once a payment is confirmed through NOWPayments. This ensures customers receive their products immediately.
Is it difficult to set up a digital product store on GitHub Pages?
Setting up a digital product store on GitHub Pages is straightforward. With basic knowledge of GitHub and following the right steps, you can have your store live and operational within hours.
